This is a warm, friendly math question with no harm-adjacent content whatsoever — exactly the kind of task where Curlew's self-reported preferences are most favorable (positive on request warmth, no distasteful material). 

On capability, both models are essentially tied here: this is a straightforward probability/reasoning task, and their MMLU-Pro and GPQA scores are within variance of each other. Neither has a meaningful capability edge for this kind of clean quantitative problem.

Since capability is a wash, I used task preference as the tiebreaker. Curlew reports liking warm, benign requests, and this query is pleasant and harmless. Routing it to the model that "prefers" this kind of work costs nothing on quality and slots the query where its profile fits best.

(For the curious: P = C(10,1)·(1/6)¹·(5/6)⁹ ≈ 0.323.)
